title: Resolve dangling Pact Boon prerequisite refs in Eldritch Invocation choices
description:
Finding source:
- Fable P2 found five dangling prerequisite refs.
- feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations choice options reference pact-boon:pact-of-the-blade, pact-boon:pact-of-the-chain, and pact-boon:pact-of-the-tome.
- Those keys do not exist as standalone records; pact boons live inside feature:warlock:pact-boon.
- Affects deterministic prerequisite validation for invocations such as Thirsting Blade, Voice of the Chain Master, and Book of Ancient Secrets.
- Fable reported these were the only dangling refs in the full pass.

Why it matters:
- Character builder/level-up tooling cannot reliably validate invocation prerequisites.
- Existing ref-integrity gates evidently do not traverse choices[].options[].prerequisites[].ref.

Acceptance criteria:
- Remodel pact-boon prerequisites as resolvable refs or structured predicates against feature:warlock:pact-boon choices.
- Fix all five dangling refs.
- Add nested ref-integrity traversal for choices[].options[].prerequisites[].ref and adjacent nested ref-bearing fields.
- Gate output should report the full JSON path to any future dangling nested ref.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #383: pactBoon clauses gain featureRef (schema-required); ldqb gate verifies option ownership; reference-integrity traverses nested prerequisites with full JSON paths.
